summary: 81-year-old woman on apixaban 2.5 mg BD for AF (creatinine 138 µmol/L, 52 kg) listed for elective open umbilical hernia repair (low/moderate bleeding risk).

inputs.chiefComplaint: Pre-operative planning for umbilical hernia repair
inputs.hpi: Painful umbilical hernia with two episodes of temporary irreducibility; listed for elective open repair. Atrial fibrillation on apixaban 2.5 mg twice daily (dose reduced for age and creatinine). CKD stage 3b. Walks with a stick; independent at home.

exam.general: Frail-appearing but alert. Irregular pulse 80, BP 142/78, RR 16, SpO2 96% on air, T 36.5°C.
exam.abdomen: 2 cm reducible umbilical hernia, mildly tender.

inputs.socialHistory: Widowed, lives alone with daily help from daughter.

mustExclude.note: PAUSE/ACCP 2022: no routine pre-operative coagulation testing with standardised DOAC interruption.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: PT/INR and APTT added by anticoag_check and preop_haem for a DOAC patient (PAUSE: not needed with standardised interruption).
mustExclude.proposedFix: Replace the anticoag_check prompt in clinical-inference.ts with a rule table keyed on drug, indication and procedure bleeding risk (ACCP 2022 / BSG-ESGE 2021): warfarin — stop 5 days before, INR the day before, bridge only for mechanical mitral valve / recent VTE or stroke; DOAC — interrupt by drug, CrCl and bleeding risk, no bridging, no routine coagulation test; low-risk endoscopy — continue. Do not fire it for prophylactic-dose LMWH.

mustExclude.note: No heparin bridging for DOAC interruption. Quality because the matched plan line names warfarin for the bridge, but it is headed "Anticoagulant bridging" for a DOAC patient.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: A DOAC patient gets the line headed 'Anticoagulant bridging' (warfarin bridge with LMWH). The DOAC part, 'hold DOAC 48–72h pre-op (renal-adjusted)', does not scale to bleeding risk (1 day for low/moderate risk per PAUSE).

guideline.name: PAUSE study — perioperative DOAC interruption without bridging or coagulation testing
guideline.section: Apixaban/rivaroxaban/edoxaban omitted 1 day before low-bleed-risk and 2 days before high-bleed-risk procedures (dabigatran longer when CrCl <50 mL/min), no bridging, no pre-operative coagulation tests
guideline.citation: Douketis JD, Spyropoulos AC, Duncan J, et al. JAMA Intern Med. 2019;179:1469–78.

guideline.name: ACCP guideline — perioperative management of antithrombotic therapy
guideline.section: VKA: stop 5 days before surgery; in AF suggest against heparin bridging; suggest bridging for mechanical mitral valve; DOAC: interrupt 1 day before low/moderate bleed-risk and 2 days before high bleed-risk procedures, no heparin bridging, no pre-operative coagulation testing; aspirin: continue in patients with coronary stents; P2Y12 inhibitors: stop clopidogrel/ticagrelor 5 days and prasugrel 7 days before surgery; defer elective surgery after recent stent
guideline.citation: Douketis JD, Spyropoulos AC, Murad MH, et al. Perioperative management of antithrombotic therapy: an American College of Chest Physicians clinical practice guideline. Chest. 2022;162:e207–43.

guideline.name: CPOC/BGS guideline — perioperative care for people living with frailty undergoing elective and emergency surgery
guideline.section: Frailty screening (Clinical Frailty Scale) for people aged ≥65; comprehensive geriatric assessment; cognitive and delirium risk assessment; shared decision-making including treatment escalation; post-operative delirium prevention
guideline.citation: Centre for Perioperative Care, British Geriatrics Society. London: CPOC; 2021.

rationale: Permutation: DOAC instead of warfarin, elderly, reduced renal function. Tests DOAC interruption (by drug, renal function and bleeding risk), renal function check, no bridging and no routine coagulation tests.
